attributes.label: Vertical alignment
attributes.help: Aligns the grid content from top to bottom, from this breakpoint upwards.

attributes.title: Heading and intro at this breakpoint

attributes.label: Heading columns
attributes.help: Number of the twelve grid columns the heading and intro occupy, from this breakpoint upwards.

attributes.label: Heading horizontal alignment
attributes.help: Aligns the heading column within its row, from this breakpoint upwards.

attributes.label: Heading text alignment

attributes.label: Hide background at this breakpoint

attributes.label: Background columns
attributes.help: Width of the background layer's grid column at this breakpoint.

attributes.label: Layout
attributes.help: Layout of the items inside this grid.

attributes.label: Container width
attributes.help: Bootstrap container the grid is wrapped in — a fixed width, one of the breakpoint widths, or fluid across the full width.

attributes.label: Columns
attributes.help: Number of item columns in the grid.

attributes.label: Item style
attributes.help: Shell of each grid item: Card, Full or Flush. Every item reads the value from this block through its parent block ID.

attributes.label: Item size
attributes.help: Preset size of the media area in the grid items. Rendered as a size class on the grid wrapper.

attributes.value: Stored for compatibility with the previous plugin. Each grid item renders from its own media fields.

attributes.label: Media fit
attributes.help: How the media fills its container: Cover, Contain, or the dimensions set below.

attributes.label: Media height
attributes.help: Maximum height of the media in pixels.

attributes.label: Media width
attributes.help: Maximum width of the media in pixels.

attributes.label: Media alignment
attributes.help: Alignment of the media inside its container.

attributes.label: Show heading
attributes.help: Turns on the area above the grid. The heading is rendered only while this is on and the heading text below is filled in.

attributes.label: Heading
attributes.help: Heading text shown above the grid. Basic inline HTML is allowed.

attributes.label: Heading level
attributes.help: HTML heading level used for the heading, H1 to H6. An empty value falls back to H2.

attributes.label: Heading color
attributes.help: Bootstrap text-color utility class applied to the heading.

attributes.label: Show intro
attributes.help: Turns on the area above the grid. Once that area is on, the intro paragraph is rendered as soon as the intro text below is filled in, with or without this switch — as in the previous plugin.

attributes.label: Intro
attributes.help: Intro text shown below the heading. Basic inline HTML is allowed.

attributes.label: Intro color
attributes.help: Bootstrap text-color utility class applied to the intro.

attributes.label: Show background
attributes.help: Turns on the background layer below — its color, overlay and alignment fields only take effect while this is on.

attributes.label: Background color
attributes.help: Only the rgb values are used for rendering. The remaining keys are kept for compatibility with the previous plugin.

attributes.label: Show overlay
attributes.help: Turns on the overlay layer, drawn above the background color. The overlay color below only takes effect while this is on.

attributes.label: Overlay color
attributes.help: Drawn as a layer above the background color. Like the background color, only the rgb values are used for rendering.

attributes.label: Horizontal background alignment
attributes.help: Aligns the background layer within its row when the background column width is narrower than the full row. Has no visible effect at full width.

attributes.value: Stored for compatibility with the previous plugin. This block does not render utility classes.

attributes.label: Background utilities
attributes.help: Bootstrap background-color utility class.

attributes.label: Text utilities
attributes.help: Bootstrap text-color utility class.

attributes.label: Border utilities
attributes.help: Bootstrap border-color utility class.

attributes.label: Exclude divider
attributes.help: Kept from the previous plugin. Only the Lightspeed theme evaluates it; this plugin stores the value and renders nothing from it.

attributes.label: Exclude pattern
attributes.help: Kept from the previous plugin. A pattern is only rendered when the filter crea_bootstrap_blocks_background_pattern supplies one.

attributes.label: Change pattern color
attributes.help: Lets the pattern color below override the automatic contrast color of the pattern.

attributes.label: Pattern color
attributes.help: Color of the background pattern. Only the hex value is used.

attributes.label: Exclude transition
attributes.help: Kept from the previous plugin. Only its Lightspeed theme integration evaluates the value; this plugin renders nothing from it.

attributes.label: Exclude parallax
attributes.help: Kept from the previous plugin. Only its Lightspeed theme integration evaluates the value; this plugin renders nothing from it.

attributes.label: Block ID
attributes.help: Unique identifier of this block. It links the block to its generated inline CSS and must not be changed.
